List installed style sets

Source: R/sets.R
designer_sets.Rd

Built-in sets ship with the package; user sets install under the user data directory and survive package updates.

Usage

designer_sets()

Value

A data frame of sets with the library they live in (core or user), the upstream repo they were installed from, and a style count.
